Name: L_Hand
Description: Hand Block with 5 fingers or less

attrs.Help_string: What this block does: Hand Block with 5 fingers or less. How to use it: fill the key fields below before build. SetParent: set the target node name. If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup. SetAttrsCtrl: set the target node name. If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup. CreateFingersAttrs: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature. CtrlSize: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 4). CtrlType: choose one option (for example: circleX, circleY, circleZ, bounding_cube). Mirror: choose one option (for example: True, False, Right_Only). Tip: if a field says left/right or mirror, use it to generate the opposite side quickly. Template parent examples: L_Hand_Ankle_Jnt, L_Hand_Palm_Jnt, Spine_End_Jnt.
